tasks.scenario: Your automated helper has been buying a well-known chip maker. Before dinner you want to know how many units of it the helper now holds. Report that number.
tasks.answer: the number of units of the chip maker the helper holds
tasks.outcome: minimize the time it takes to know what I hold

tasks.scenario: A friend asked what your helper paid, on average, for each unit of the chip maker. You want to tell them the figure in dollars.
tasks.answer: the average price paid per unit, in dollars, to the cent
tasks.outcome: minimize the time it takes to know what I paid

tasks.scenario: You remember the helper sold a contract that pays off if a cloud company falls. You want to know the date that contract runs out.
tasks.answer: the date the contract runs out
tasks.outcome: minimize the chance of missing a date that matters
